title: A Typewriter for the Regiment
author: Oscar Dravenmoor
blurb: Quentin Vasquez, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the ice breaks on the river.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
